div.div:
Primary key (PK). CustomerID uniquely identifies each customer in the Customer table.
Foreign key (FK). SalesOrder.CustomerID stores the CustomerID of the customer who placed each order. Orders 62 and 85 both point to Walters PLC, customer 1.
